newsitem.title: USA: ECRI drops press version of wkly US inflation data.
newsitem.headline: ECRI drops press version of wkly US inflation data.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) said it will no longer release its weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) to the press, choosing instead to focus on its monthly inflation indicator.

"We have noticed that there has been much more media interest in ECRI's monthly releases than in the weekly updates," ECRI said. "We have also been advised by some members of the press that they would pay even more attention to the FIG press releases if they were less frequent."
ECRI subscribers will continue to receive the weekly FIG, ECRI said.
The next ECRI monthly inflation index is set for release Friday, May 2.
